items.title: Relief for defaulters fails to stem bad loans
items.description: Bad loans in the country’s banking sector continue to rise despite years of generous forbearance measures by the central bank, including loan restructuring, rescheduling, interest waivers and one-time exit facilities.

items.title: Everest replaces Saif Powertec as interim CCT operator
items.description: Local logistics company Everest Port Services Ltd has won a six-month contract to operate Chittagong Container Terminal (CCT) at Chattogram port, replacing local operator Saif Powertec Ltd.

items.title: Oil’s Iran war recovery masks a stubborn diesel shortage
items.description: Nine months into the biggest energy shock in modern history, the oil market’s recovery is surprisingly swift, but plentiful crude supplies are masking a stubborn diesel shortage that could yet upend fuel markets.

items.title: Vietnam builds commodity exchange to boost farm produce
items.description: In a bid to move from a major agricultural producer to a global price-setter, Vietnam is laying the groundwork for a domestic commodity derivatives market.

items.title: BRAC Bank, Heidelberg Materials partner to strengthen distributor financing
items.description: BRAC Bank PLC has signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with Heidelberg Materials Bangladesh PLC, one of the country’s largest cement manufacturers, to provide distributor-financing facilities to the company’s distribution network.
